digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership and legacy facade removal (RP-04 contract phase)
propositions: Enforce centralized ownership of configuration reads through a deterministic AST gate that rejects direct ambient access patterns (load_config, os.getenv, os.environ, getattr equivalents, backend property reload) below approved composition seams.
Generate authoritative configuration and security lifecycle documentation from the schema and ownership registries, covering precedence, source, restart behavior, and provider-neutral deltas.
Wire the ownership guard into make lint and CI such that both ownership-direction and field-consumption gates execute, and parity tests fail if either gate is omitted.

Remove legacy facades, switches, and migration exceptions only after all structural tests pass, behavioral suites remain green, and bounded live canaries (provider, AWS review-bot, reconciler) succeed with redacted evidence.

Every newly declared config or credential name must map to exactly one approved owner, with no path-glob exceptions, exact rationales for test-only controls, and an empty legacy exception set before closure.
The AST gate acts as a deterministic change detector for static access forms, supplementing but not replacing behavioral regression oracles from S1-S6.
